properties.name: query-audit.enabled
properties.description: Master switch for the entire auto-configuration. When `false`, the `QueryInterceptor` bean and the wrapping `BeanPostProcessor` are both skipped — the `@QueryAudit` annotation will not work either. Use `wrap-data-source.enabled: false` instead if you want to keep the interceptor active but skip the auto-wrap.

properties.name: query-audit.profile
properties.description: Rule tier: `recommended` (call-site N+1 only), `minimal` (N+1, index, and write safety), or `strict` (all rules). See [Rule Profiles](#rule-profiles).

properties.name: query-audit.enabled-rules
properties.description: Rule codes to run even when the profile tier excludes them. `disabled-rules` still wins.

properties.name: query-audit.mode
properties.description: Which tests the JUnit extension audits: `annotated` (opt-in via `@QueryAudit`) or `all` (every test, opt-out via `@QueryAuditExclude`). `all` additionally requires JUnit extension autodetection — see [Audit Coverage Mode](#audit-coverage-mode).

properties.name: query-audit.contracts.path
properties.description: Query contracts for test methods and `QueryContractScope`: one file, or a directory whose `*.contracts` files are all read. See [contracts](contracts.md).

properties.name: query-audit.await-executors
properties.description: Bean names of `ThreadPoolTaskExecutor` or `ThreadPoolExecutor` pools that audited test methods and the injected `QueryContractScope` wait for. See [Background Work](#background-work).

properties.name: query-audit.wrap-data-source.enabled
properties.description: Surgical escape hatch (issue #134) — disables only the auto-wrap `BeanPostProcessor` while keeping `QueryInterceptor` and `QueryAuditConfig` beans active. Use this when integrating with an existing datasource-proxy (e.g. gavlyukovskiy).

properties.name: query-audit.fail-on-detection
properties.description: Whether confirmed issues (ERROR/WARNING) should cause the test to fail with an `AssertionError`.

properties.name: query-audit.count-instead-of-exists.enabled
properties.description: Enable the `count-instead-of-exists` INFO detector. Off by default because it can fire on legitimate aggregate counts.

properties.name: query-audit.connection-held-idle.threshold-ms
properties.description: Minimum idle time (connection held minus database work) before the `connection-held-idle` rule fires. Requires the non-DB work to actually take time in tests — zero-latency mocks never reproduce the gap.

properties.name: query-audit.repeated-insert.exclude-tables
properties.description: Table-name globs (case-insensitive, `*` wildcard) treated as deliberate staging targets — repeated single-row inserts into these tables are not flagged.

properties.name: query-audit.repeated-update.exclude-tables
properties.description: Case-insensitive table-name globs excluded from repeated single-row UPDATE detection. Replace with `[]` to inspect every table.

properties.name: query-audit.n-plus-one.threshold
properties.description: Number of times a structurally identical query must repeat before it is flagged as N+1.

properties.name: query-audit.offset-pagination.threshold
properties.description: The OFFSET value that triggers a warning.

properties.name: query-audit.or-clause.threshold
properties.description: Number of OR conditions in a single WHERE clause before flagging.

properties.name: query-audit.suppress-patterns
properties.description: Issue codes or qualified patterns to suppress globally. See [Suppressing Issues](suppressing.md).

properties.name: query-audit.suppress-queries
properties.description: SQL query substrings to suppress (e.g., health-check queries). Case-insensitive substring match.

properties.name: query-audit.baseline-path
properties.description: Path to the finding baseline file. When `null`, uses `.query-audit-baseline` in the working directory.

properties.name: query-audit.auto-open-report
properties.description: Whether to open the selected HTML report after tests. Ignored for `console` and `json`.

properties.name: query-audit.max-queries
properties.description: Maximum number of queries retained per test. If additional queries are dropped, the audit fails as incomplete.

properties.name: query-audit.report.format
properties.description: Suite artifact: `console` writes no file, `json` writes `report.json`, and `html` writes the browser report. Per-test console diagnostics remain available for every selection.

properties.name: query-audit.report.output-dir
properties.description: Directory used by the selected JSON or HTML report.

properties.name: query-audit.report.show-info
properties.description: Whether unacknowledged INFO findings appear in console, HTML, and GitHub Actions display. Canonical run JSON and sink summaries retain them for trustworthy comparisons; analysis and query statistics are unchanged.

properties.name: query-audit.disabled-rules
properties.description: Rule codes to completely disable.

properties.name: query-audit.severity-overrides
properties.description: Override severity per rule code (e.g., `select-all: WARNING`).

properties.name: query-audit.large-in-list.threshold
properties.description: Number of values in IN clause before flagging.

properties.name: query-audit.too-many-joins.threshold
properties.description: Number of JOINs before flagging.

properties.name: query-audit.excessive-column.threshold
properties.description: Number of selected columns before flagging.

properties.name: query-audit.repeated-insert.threshold
properties.description: Number of repeated single-row INSERTs before flagging.

properties.name: query-audit.repeated-update.threshold
properties.description: Number of repeated single-row UPDATEs with the same normalized shape before flagging.

properties.name: query-audit.write-amplification.threshold
properties.description: Number of indexes per table before flagging write amplification.

properties.name: query-audit.slow-query.warning-ms
properties.description: Execution time (ms) that triggers a WARNING-level slow query.

properties.name: query-audit.slow-query.error-ms
properties.description: Execution time (ms) that triggers an ERROR-level slow query.

properties.name: query-audit.report.redaction
properties.description: Accepts redacted (the default) or full. The default removes SQL values, comments, raw diagnostic prose, and framework/absolute-path stack details from JSON and GitHub Actions output. It does not change findings or enforcement. Use full only for local debugging; see [machine report redaction](reports.md#machine-report-redaction).
